pages.text: Thaws a whole food stack in $(bold)10 seconds$(), anywhere.

pages.title: How to Use
pages.text: Food in your $(bold)offhand$(), warmer in your $(bold)main hand$(), right-click.$(br2)Progress shows above the hotbar. Walk, switch slots or stow the warmer; it keeps going.

pages.title: Results
pages.text: $(bold)Chilled, Frozen$(): fresh again$(br)$(bold)Frost-Ruined$(): damaged Frozen at best$(br)$(bold)Fresh, frost-resistant$(): no charge used$(br2)Thawed food gets a $(bold)30 s$() warm window, shown in its tooltip.

pages.title: Cancelling
pages.text: Keep the same full stack in your offhand until it finishes.$(br2)Removing, replacing, eating or splitting it, dying, changing dimension or leaving cancels with $(danger)no refund$().
Four iron corners, four copper edges, redstone center. Crafted $(bold)empty$(). No Nether parts.
$(bold)1-4 redstone$() anywhere in the grid: one charge each, four max. Extra dust stays put; device data is kept.

pages.title: Specs
pages.text: $(li)4 charges, spent at the start$(li)10 s per thaw$(li)30 s warm window$(li)Food only: no body warmth or frostbite protection$(li)Nothing thaws early; a job can't move to another stack$(br2)$(flavor)Not a pillow.$()
